format: single Crumbl cookie bakery location (leased space, approx. 1,600 to 2,000 sq ft)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a Crumbl® franchise is $848,566 to $1,472,533. This includes the $81,000 to $89,000 that must be paid to the franchisor or its affiliates.

fee.quote: On the signing of the franchise agreement, all franchisees pay an initial franchise fee of $50,000.
fee.note: Also paid to franchisor/affiliate: opening tech equipment package $12,000 to $15,000, opening box and ingredient package $11,000 to $16,000, initial training fee $8,000. Area development: $50,000 per unit up front, minimum 3 units, credited to each initial fee.

royalty.quote: Royalty*1 8% of gross sales Payable weekly to be received by Tuesday of the following week (a sales week runs Monday – Saturday)

adFund.quote: Marketing Fund Fee*1,2 2% of gross sales payable to us ... Advertising Cooperative*1,2 1% to 2% of gross sales payable to the co-op, if established by us
adFund.note: Local marketing requirement 0 to 2% of gross sales, currently 0%. Co-op 1% to 2% if established.

otherRecurring.name: Gift Card Program Fee
otherRecurring.amount: 5% to 15% of the redemption value of the gift card

otherRecurring.name: Store Inspection Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, the cost of the services, plus a 5% to 15% administrative fee (two to four inspections per year)

headline.label: Average annual gross sales, 776 franchised Crumbl locations open all of 2025 that timely submitted complete financial reports (74% of 1,048)

item19.quote: 2025 Calendar Year Average Median High Store Low Store Gross Sales $1,139,162 $1,093,071 $3,421,762 $365,129
item19.note: Sales only: 'The financial performance representation figures do not reflect the costs or expenses...'. Subset: 272 locations excluded for not timely submitting complete financial information, 53 for not operating the whole year. 346 (approx. 45%) met or surpassed the average.

special: Royalty 8% plus 2% marketing fund plus $650 monthly technology fee; transaction processing fee of 2.4% to 4% of each transaction is paid to the franchisor, which keeps the difference over the processor's cost (about 2.36%). Required purchases of tech and box/ingredient packages from franchisor or affiliate. $30,000 minimum working capital must be kept in the operating account. Investment excludes purchase of real property (lease assumed, rent $50,000 to $250,000 per annum).
issues: Items 5-19 were not cut in the items file; figures taken by grep of the full text. Item 19 covers only the 74% of full-year locations that reported on time.
